en.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they learn you are the Nightwatchman.
en.flavor: The night is cold and lonely, but I have the moon, the stars, the crisp wind and the soft thud of leather boots on cobbled stone for company. Yonder, candlelight flickers behind a murky window...
